page.title: Cargo and crates
page.desc: Rust's build tool and package manager; crates are published to crates.io, versions follow semver, and Cargo.lock pins the exact dependency graph.
page.intro: Rust's build tool and package manager; crates are published to crates.io, versions follow semver, and Cargo.lock pins the exact dependency graph.

synapses.lead: One tool for build, test, docs
synapses.text: cargo build, cargo test, cargo doc and cargo publish cover the whole workflow; the uniformity is part of why the ecosystem feels coherent.
Cargo.lock records resolved versions so a fresh checkout builds the same graph.
